notes: Seed URL works over https. No Clarity site (elections.json 404). The Election Information page posts one unofficial county-totals file per election (Electionware 'Summary Results Report' or the SOS 'Election Unofficial Results Report') and later official canvass reports; no unofficial precinct-level report is posted for any target election, and the 2024 general has no precinct-level file at all (the 'Official Canvass Precinct Summary' on the page belongs to the Nov 4, 2025 election). 2024 general and 2026 primary unofficial files were printed and uploaded on election night; the 2026 runoff unofficial file (printed 8:54 PM) was uploaded May 28.
tag_rationale: All three elections are LATER (county totals only; precinct numbers only in official canvass reports or never posted), so the tag is COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS; confidence med because the 2024 general and 2026 primary were settled by check 2 with printed and upload times on election night.

Only other 2024 general result file is 'OFFICIAL RESULTS - Election Summary'; no precinct-level results posted.
